idea: Internal web app lets hourly retail employees post and claim shift swaps themselves, with manager approval required only when the swap changes total weekly hours beyond a threshold.
customer: The hourly retail employees who want to trade shifts among themselves without asking a manager every time, and the store manager who only wants to be pulled in when a swap changes someone's total weekly hours past the threshold.
pieces: not decomposed -- moved here from problems/ during cleanup: its old pieces were hand-authored by Claude before the 'never predefine the pieces' rule was established. See BRIDGE.md and README.md.
